name: Tamayura ~Ryoujoku Side~
source:
Touma is an ordinary student who live sister Nami and sister-in-law Kasumi. But their parents go on a trip during Golden Week and don't return. One day Touma learns that his sister received an e-mail from classmate asking for help, and thus she went to a designated place. But it all turned out to be conspiracy of the school's president...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-january-2006-io.html]vndbreview[/url]]
